# Dotfiles
> Minimalist macOS & Linux developer environment featuring Zsh, Starship, Neovim, Tmux, and Homebrew automated setup.

- Neovim IDE: https://dotfiles.io/editor/index.html
- Git & Signing: https://dotfiles.io/git/index.html
- Aliases: https://dotfiles.io/aliases/index.html
- Security: https://dotfiles.io/security/index.html
- Benchmarks: https://dotfiles.io/benchmarks/index.html
- About Sebastien Rousseau: https://dotfiles.io/about/index.html
